news.title: Celebrity Fashions Limited announced that it has received INR 50.208999 million in funding from Paradisal Precision Private Limited and other investors
news.body: On March 21, 2026, Celebrity Fashions Limited closed the transaction. The company issued 4,869,933 shares at an issue price of INR 10.31 for gross proceeds of INR 50,209,009.23.  The transaction includes participation from returning investor, Paradisal Precision Private Limited for 2,202,620 shares, held 5.24% stake and now will hold 8.26% stake, Venkatesh Rajagopal for 484,966 shares, held 18.36% stake and now will hold 17.73% stake, Rama Rajagopal for 484,966 shares and held 15.06% stake and now will hold 14.67% stake, and from new investors, Vidyuth Rajagopal for 484,966 shares and will hold 0.75% stake, and Manoj Mohenka for 1,212,415 shares and will hold 1.88% stake. The transaction has been approved by the board of directors.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.4% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Debt is not well covered by operating cash flow (11% operating cash flow to total debt).
